resources.string: The current media app could not be opened.
Please grant notification access to enable media controls.

Timer or title freezes after unlocking or returning home? Samsung can suspend OnCue even while its widget is visible. Open app settings below, then Battery → Unrestricted. This allows background updates; it does not mean unlimited battery consumption. OnCue stops periodic timer updates while paused or when the screen is off or locked. Battery impact varies and has not been quantified. You can switch back to Optimized at any time, but updates may freeze again.
